cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(tiny_a C)
set(TINY_A_VALUE 1 CACHE STRING "what tiny_a returns")
add_library(tiny_a STATIC tiny_a.c)
if(APPLE)
    target_sources(tiny_a PRIVATE tiny_a_zlib.c)
    # a header that differs between the architectures of a platform (otok-toml.md 4)
    file(WRITE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tiny_a_arch.h "#define TINY_A_ARCH \"${CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES}\"\n")
    target_include_directories(tiny_a PRIVATE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
    install(FILES ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tiny_a_arch.h DESTINATION include)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(tiny_a PRIVATE TINY_A_VALUE=${TINY_A_VALUE})
install(TARGETS tiny_a ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES tiny_a.h DESTINATION include)
